description: A painterly, dim winter street with snow on the ground. A dark armoured personnel carrier with a gun turret sits at right, smoke drifting from it. Four soldiers in long greatcoats and helmets gather round a burning oil drum for warmth, and a fifth with a rifle walks on the left. On the left, a few women in shawls stand in a dark doorway of an old stone building with shuttered shopfronts. No visible text or frame.
